title: 소리와 모양으로 말하기: 두근두근, 꼬르륵, 주룩주룩
objective: By the end, you can pick the right sound or shape word for a body feeling, the weather, food texture, or a way of moving, and use it in a short sentence with its usual verb, such as 소리가 나다, 울다, or 아프다.
summary: Learn ten common Korean sound and shape words for the body, feelings, weather, and food, and use them in everyday sentences.

task.title: Use sound and shape words
task.line: Read each sentence or situation, then choose, write, or fix the word that matches the sound or movement.

words.exampleMeaning: My heart was pounding before the interview.

words.meaning: the growling sound of an empty stomach
words.example: 회의 중에 배에서 꼬르륵 소리가 났어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My stomach growled during the meeting.

words.meaning: nodding off, with the head dropping again and again
words.example: 점심을 먹고 수업 시간에 꾸벅꾸벅 졸았어요.
words.exampleMeaning: After lunch, I kept nodding off in class.

words.meaning: sleeping soundly (the sound of deep sleep)
words.example: 아이가 엄마 옆에서 쿨쿨 자고 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The child is sound asleep next to Mom.

words.example: 감기 때문에 밤새 콜록콜록 기침을 했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I coughed all night because of my cold.

words.example: 잠을 못 자서 머리가 지끈지끈 아파요.
words.exampleMeaning: I couldn't sleep, so my head is throbbing.
I cried my eyes out at the last scene of the movie.

words.example: 아침부터 비가 주룩주룩 와서 약속을 취소했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: It has been pouring since morning, so I canceled my plans.

words.example: 이 집 튀김은 바삭바삭해서 인기가 많아요.
words.exampleMeaning: This place's fried food is crispy, so it's very popular.

words.meaning: quietly, on tiptoe, so no one notices
words.example: 아기가 깰까 봐 살금살금 방에서 나왔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I tiptoed out of the room so the baby wouldn't wake up.

exercises: Choose the right word: 시험 결과를 기다리면서 가슴이 (두근두근 / 바삭바삭) 뛰었어요.
Fill in the blank with a word from the list: ① 우산을 안 가져왔는데 밖에 비가 ____ 내리네요. ② 조용한 도서관에서 배에서 ____ 소리가 나서 창피했어요.
Write the word from the list that fits each situation: ① 옆 사람이 버스에서 고개를 앞으로 숙이며 졸고 있어요. ② 갓 구운 쿠키를 한 입 깨물었어요. ③ 밤늦게 들어와서 가족이 깨지 않게 조용히 걸어요.
Each sentence has the wrong word. Write the correct word: ① 동생이 소파에서 콜록콜록 자고 있어요. ② 목이 부어서 하루 종일 지끈지끈 기침을 해요. ③ 회의가 너무 길어서 머리가 주룩주룩 아파요.
Fill in the blank with a word from the list: 친구와 크게 싸운 날 밤에 혼자 방에서 ____ 울었어요.
answers: ① 꾸벅꾸벅 ② 바삭바삭 ③ 살금살금
① 쿨쿨 ② 콜록콜록 ③ 지끈지끈
